title: Nobunaga no Yabou Tenshouki with Power-Up Kit
native_title: 信長の野望・天翔記 ｗｉｔｈ パワーアップキット
overview: Nobunaga no Yabou: Tenshouki with Power-Up Kit is a re-released version of the same game for the Sega Saturn, adding the contents of the game's expansion pack (or "power-up kit" as it is known in this context).
